title: Monthly options expiration (October)
source: OCC: theocc.com expiration calendar — 3rd-Friday standard, checked 2026-08-18
notes: Standard monthly expiration — the 3rd-Friday cycle, not a quarterly witching (opex-2026-09-18 and opex-2026-12-18 bracket it, both impact high). AMENDED by its own 2026-09-09 D37 pulse with two facts the impact tier should be read against. FIRST, the mechanic is a null at this scale: scripts/research/expiration-displacement.mjs, run --fresh that day, puts the monthly expiration-day relative-volume separation at 0.11 (n=91, 2015+) against 1.08 for quarterlies, and the vendor post-opex 'window of weakness' does not appear in SPY on returns (permutation P = 0.716, sign opposite the claim) or realized vol (post/pre 5-day ratio median 0.955, P = 0.463). Nothing about this date licenses a gamma-shaped read. SECOND, this series has a job a month before its own expiry: VIX AM-settles to the special opening quotation of the SINGLE SPX/SPXW series exactly 30 days out, so the 2026-10-16 chain is the strip behind vix-expiration-2026-09-16. Impact stays medium on calendar grounds rather than mechanical ones — 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-16 is October's densest macro week (cpi-2026-10-14 and retail-sales-2026-10-15 are both high and confirmed; industrial-production, import-export-prices, tic-monthly and treasury-primary-dealer-agenda all print on the 16th itself), and fomc-blackout-start-2026-10-17 opens the session after. Ledger: docs/research/events/opex-2026-10-16.md.
